description: Validate this wire envelope with Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema, then pass the complete facts collection unchanged to schema/abi.py validate(). Both steps are mandatory. Each [relation, arguments] maps identically to that F1 relation and its positional columns: no renaming, coercion, defaults or inferred rows. contract.json is the sole authority for column order and semantic types. F1 validates arity, exact text, canonical keys/paths/priorities, statuses, references, scopes and completeness consistency. This schema deliberately does not duplicate those rules. Empty facts are transportable but cannot establish a successful extraction or passing oracle. Validation does not prove budget enforcement, atomic publication or source admission.

facts.description: Unordered Step 0 F1 tuples. Capability, phase, target, request-result, observation and diagnostic records use their existing nx_* relations, including failures before targets exist. Each nx_observations row carries exactly one typed subject link through nx_observation_options, nx_observation_definitions, nx_observation_contexts or nx_observation_modules, enforced by F1. Omitted facts never manufacture successful observations or completion.

title: NixQL observation transport, version one
